requirements.description: User wants the property located near public transport. Set at the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71) to meet the 'near' threshold.

User prefers energy class C or better, so the classes A1 through C are accepted. The energy_score_class column cannot separate C from D and E, so energy_class is used instead. The surface area, capacity, and public transport requirements are not energy-related and are not extracted.

output.explanation: Filters residential property types (continuous or occasional occupancy) with surface_area >= 140, energy_class in A1-A4/B/C, mobility score >= 71, and a 3.0 km haversine radius around the supplied coordinates. Results are ordered by distance to that point. No LIMIT applied.
